name: Uncle Arnie's | 100mg Drink | Pineapple Paradise
description:
Uncle Arnie’s Pineapple Paradise packs a perfect punch, in both potency and flavor. Set sail to an island of bliss with this 100mg tropical trip. . Uncle Arnie brings the party, whether its backyards, beaches, boats, or BBQ’s, you’ll set adrift with an onset time of about 20-40mins, and of course sip according to your experience!

VEGAN. MADE IN THE USA.
